title: Turning an empty patch into a pollinator corner
summary: Mary fills the open center of a flower border with bee balm, sunflower, lavender, and daisies until the patch reads as a finished garden corner.
whyToday: The transformation format gives viewers a clear before, active middle, and finished payoff while showing several real Basil flower choices.
hook: Can this empty patch become a pollinator corner?
narration: Can this empty patch become a pollinator corner? I left the middle open and started with bee balm, then added sunflower, lavender, and a few daisies. There is no perfect arrangement. I just look for the next space that feels too quiet. Seven flowers later, the empty patch reads like a place instead of a gap. That is usually enough for me.
sourceNote: Founder narration grounded in Basil's real flower catalog and deterministic planting replay.
outroLine: Build a corner of your own.
